verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Apple's own claim that M4 Max 'delivers exceptional battery life in a laptop' (docs-6). It gives no runtime figures and no independent battery testing, and nothing shows the chip shipping in fanless, thin, or quiet designs. The other cited M4 Max system is the Mac Studio desktop. Missing for 10: fanless or low-power design evidence, quantified battery-life figures, independent or hands-on battery-life corroboration, thermal and noise evidence.
